newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nemic-Lambda to form joint venture in South Korea.
newsitem.headline: Nemic-Lambda to form joint venture in South Korea.

text.p: Nemic-Lambda KK said on Thursday that it would form a joint venture in South Korea to produce and sell switching regulators.
Phoenix Nemic-Lambda Co Ltd, to be set up in August, will be 50 percent owned by the Nemic-Lambda group and 50 percent by Korean partners, including Bokwang Co Ltd, Nemic-Lambda said in a statement.
The joint venture will start operations in January 1998 and sales are expected to hit 1.5 billion yen in the initial year, rising to six billion yen in four years' time, the Japanese company said.
Switching regulators are used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and other forms of manufacturing equipment, the company said.
